purpose: Preserve the distinction between an empty workflow-run query and evidence that a workflow failed or did not exist.

observed_provider_result.query_scope: GitHub connector commit workflow-run query; first page; pull-request-triggered runs only
observed_provider_result.claim_boundary: An empty result does not establish absence of push-triggered, manually dispatched, delayed, or otherwise unreturned workflow runs.

verification.route: dependency-free Node test suite executed before repository write
covered_boundaries: empty result remains unobserved rather than failed

limits: No provider workflow run was observed.
No browser or physical-device audio claim is made.
